mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and increased production costs, which negatively impacts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE < 4% and 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals strong consumer demand, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases for 3 consecutive months and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 2% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO MoM < -2% and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS < 1% and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE > 0.5% MoM and PAYEMS < 0% MoM and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a decrease in housing starts (HOUST) during a recession signals reduced consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST decreases > 5% MoM during a recession and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a combination of falling GDP (GDPC1) and rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals a supply-side recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 < 0% QoQ and INDPRO > 0% MoM and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the triggered instances.
